label: Encyclopedia itself
summary: Going by its name, the encyclopedia object itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Open encyclopedia page
summary: Makes the encyclopedia show the page given to it.
details: Vanilla calls it on a click with the page itself as the argument: `Encyclopedia.SetCurrentPage( EncyclopediaPage.AccessSelf )`. It returns nothing.

label: View all entries
summary: Switches the encyclopedia to its list of all entries.
details: Vanilla uses it on a button click in the encyclopedia window. The exact view it switches to is judged from the name. It returns nothing.

label: Entry itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the encyclopedia entry itself, so it can be passed to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Entry text
summary: The body text of an encyclopedia entry.
details: Vanilla sets the `text` of a widget in the encyclopedia window to it. It returns a string.

label: Entry image frame
summary: The frame number (a whole number) of an encyclopedia entry's picture.
details: Vanilla sets a widget's `frame` to it in the encyclopedia window. That it picks one frame of a multi-frame image is judged from the name and that use.

label: Entry frame size
summary: The size (width and height, as two whole numbers) of the frames of an entry's picture.
details: Vanilla sets a widget's `framesize` to it in the encyclopedia window.

label: Entry image
summary: The picture of an encyclopedia entry.
details: Vanilla sets a widget's `texture` to it in the encyclopedia window. The game gives no return type.

label: Entry title
summary: The title of an encyclopedia entry.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text of a widget in the encyclopedia window. It returns a string.

label: Entry has image
summary: Whether the encyclopedia entry has a picture.
details: Vanilla uses it to decide whether a widget is visible in the encyclopedia window.

label: Entry itself
summary: Going by its name, the encyclopedia entry itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Entry view itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the encyclopedia entry view itself, so it can be passed to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Current entry view
summary: Gets the entry view the encyclopedia window works with.
details: Vanilla uses it as the `datacontext` (the object a widget reads its data from) in the encyclopedia window. What exactly it returns is judged from that use and the name. The game gives no return type.

label: Entry view itself
summary: Going by its name, the encyclopedia entry view itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Page itself
summary: Gives access to the encyclopedia page itself, so it can be passed to other functions.
details: Vanilla passes it to `Encyclopedia.SetCurrentPage` to open that page. The game gives no return type.

label: Filter from text
summary: Filters the page's entries by the text typed in the search box.
details: Vanilla calls it when Return is pressed in the search field (`onreturnpressed`). The way it filters is judged from its name. It returns nothing.

label: Page title
summary: The title of an encyclopedia page.
details: Vanilla shows it as widget text and in the search tooltip ("Find entries in '[page title]' whose headings match the text entered"). It returns a string.

label: Reset filter
summary: Clears the filter on the page's entries.
details: Vanilla calls it on a button click in the encyclopedia window. That it clears the filter is judged from the name. It returns nothing.

label: Search entered text
summary: Searches the page's entries using the text entered in the search box.
details: Vanilla calls it on a click on the search button. That it searches is judged from the name. It returns nothing.

label: Page itself
summary: The encyclopedia page itself, usable for comparing it with another page.
details: Vanilla compares it with the current page: `ObjectsEqual( Encyclopedia.GetCurrentPage, EncyclopediaPage.Self )`. Vanilla uses that result to set a widget's pressed look (`down`) and its visibility. The game gives no return type.

label: Confirmation itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the end-preparation confirmation object itself.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Cancel
summary: Cancels the confirmation question.
details: Vanilla calls it on a button click in the multiplayer interface file (multiplayer_types.gui). Going by the type's name it is the "end preparation" confirmation of multiplayer. It returns nothing.

label: Confirm
summary: Confirms the question.
details: Vanilla calls it on a button click in the multiplayer interface file (multiplayer_types.gui). Going by the type's name it is the "end preparation" confirmation of multiplayer. It returns nothing.

label: Confirmation itself
summary: Going by its name, the end-preparation confirmation object itself.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Entity editor itself
summary: The entity editor itself, to hand it on to another function.
details: The entity editor is a tool of the game engine for a 3D entity's animations and their events. Vanilla passes it to AddStartEventKeyframe of an event layer. The game lists no return type.

label: Add audio layer
summary: Adds an audio layer (a timeline lane for sound events) to the animation being edited.
details: Vanilla runs it only from an invisible zero-size button that carries a keyboard shortcut, next to the "Add Layer..." button. It returns nothing.

label: Add entity removal layer
summary: Adds a layer (a timeline lane) for events that remove an entity to the animation being edited.
details: Vanilla runs it only from an invisible zero-size button that carries a keyboard shortcut, next to the "Add Layer..." button. It returns nothing.

label: Add entity spawn layer
summary: Adds a layer (a timeline lane) for events that spawn an entity to the animation being edited.
details: Vanilla runs it only from an invisible zero-size button that carries a keyboard shortcut, next to the "Add Layer..." button. It returns nothing.

label: Add keyframe at mouse
summary: Adds a keyframe at the mouse position to the timeline lane under the mouse.
details: Vanilla runs it only through a keyboard shortcut, from a hidden button that its comment calls a workaround to make shortcuts work. It returns nothing.

label: Add keyframe at needle
summary: Adds a keyframe at the needle (the current time marker of the timeline) to the lane under the mouse.
details: Vanilla runs it only through a keyboard shortcut, from a hidden button. It returns nothing.

label: Add visual effect layer
summary: Adds a layer (a timeline lane) for visual effects to the animation being edited.
details: Vanilla runs it only from an invisible zero-size button that carries a keyboard shortcut, next to the "Add Layer..." button. It returns nothing.

label: Can interact
summary: Whether the user can work with the keyframes in the entity editor right now.
details: Vanilla enables the editor's keyframe area only while this is true.

label: Animation end time
summary: The end of the timeline for the animation being edited, a decimal number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the maximum of the entity editor's timeline, which starts at 0. The editor shows animation times in seconds.

label: Delete keyframe
summary: Deletes the given keyframe from the animation being edited.
details: Vanilla runs it from a small close button next to each start event in the entity editor's properties tab, passing that keyframe. It returns nothing.

label: Edited entity
summary: The entity (3D object) the entity editor is working on.
details: Vanilla reads many details through it: whether it has unsaved changes, its states and animation, the current frame and time, its scale and joints. The game lists no return type.

label: Frame entity
summary: Moves the entity editor's camera so the whole entity is in view.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Frame Entity" button. It returns nothing.

label: Last autosave duration
summary: How long the entity editor's last save took, in seconds, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla shows it with two decimals in "Last save at: ... (in ...s)".

label: Last autosave time
summary: The time of the entity editor's last save.
details: Vanilla shows it in "Last save at: ...", only while a last save time is known. The game lists no return type.

label: Has entities
summary: Whether the entity editor has any entities.
details: Vanilla shows part of the editor only while this is true and nothing is loading.

label: Has entity
summary: Whether the entity editor has an entity to work on.
details: Vanilla checks it before reading the entity's states, and shows the properties tab only while it is true and nothing is loading.

label: Has save time
summary: Whether a time of the entity editor's last save is known.
details: Vanilla shows the "Last save at" line only while this is true.

label: Is autosaving
summary: Whether the entity editor is saving automatically right now.
details: While it is true, vanilla shows "Auto Saving to User Folder...".

label: Is grid shown
summary: Whether the entity editor shows its grid.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of the "Toggle Grid" button.

label: Is loading
summary: Whether the entity editor is still loading.
details: Vanilla hides parts of the editor, such as the properties tab, while this is true.

label: Is scrubbing
summary: Whether the user is dragging along the entity editor's timeline right now.
details: While it is true, vanilla shows the entity's current time in seconds next to the timeline.

label: Is world muted
summary: Whether all sound except the entity editor's own is muted.
details: Vanilla switches the mute button's look with it: "Mute everything except this tool" while sound is on, "Unmute everything" while it is muted.

label: Needle follows keyframe
summary: Whether the needle (the current time marker) moves along when a keyframe is dragged.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of the toggle button with the tooltip "Toggle to make the needle move when moving a keyframe."

label: Add layer click
summary: Reacts to a click on the entity editor's "Add Layer..." button.
details: Vanilla runs it from that button; the layer types for audio, visual effects, spawning and removal each have their own function, which vanilla runs only from invisible shortcut buttons. It returns nothing.

label: Keyframe click
summary: Reacts to a click on a keyframe in the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla runs it from each keyframe button, passing the button widget first and the keyframe second. It returns nothing.

label: Keyframe moved
summary: Reacts to a keyframe being dragged along the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla runs it from each keyframe button while it is moved, passing the button widget first and the keyframe second. It returns nothing.

label: Keyframe pressed
summary: Reacts to the mouse button going down on a keyframe in the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla runs it from each keyframe button, passing the button widget first and the keyframe second. It returns nothing.

label: Keyframe released
summary: Reacts to the mouse button being let go on a keyframe in the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla runs it from each keyframe button, passing the button widget first and the keyframe second, together with OnScrubEnd. It returns nothing.

label: Keyframe right-click
summary: Reacts to a right-click on a keyframe in the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla runs it from each keyframe button, passing the keyframe. It returns nothing.

label: Layer right-click
summary: Reacts to a right-click on a layer (a timeline lane) in the entity editor.
details: Vanilla runs it from the layer's row, passing the layer. It returns nothing.

label: Scrub end
summary: Finishes the user's drag along the entity editor's timeline, or of a keyframe.
details: Vanilla runs it when the timeline slider's change finishes (commented as clean-up) and when the mouse is let go on a keyframe. It returns nothing.

label: Scrub start
summary: Starts a drag along the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla runs it when the user starts changing the timeline slider; its comment says it makes sure it is a user action that moves the player. It returns nothing.

label: Open event editor
summary: Opens the event editor for the given keyframe.
details: Vanilla runs it on a double-click on a keyframe in the timeline and from the "Edit ..." button of a start event in the properties tab. It returns nothing.

fields.name: keyframe
fields.text: The keyframe whose event is edited.

label: Save all entities
summary: Saves the changes made to all entities into the game folder.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Save All Entities" button, whose tooltip says it saves to the game folder. Automatic saves go to the user folder instead. It returns nothing.

label: Scrub animation
summary: Moves the animation to the point the user drags the timeline slider to.
details: Vanilla runs it each time the slider's value changes, between OnScrubStart and OnScrubEnd. It returns nothing.

label: Entity editor itself
summary: Going by its name, the entity editor itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Set clicked lane
summary: Remembers which layer lane of the timeline was right-clicked.
details: Vanilla runs it on a right-click on a keyframe lane, passing that lane's layer. It returns nothing.

fields.name: layer
fields.text: The layer whose lane was clicked.

label: Set move with keyframe
summary: Going by its name, sets whether the playhead moves along when a keyframe is moved.
details: It takes one argument, presumably yes or no. It returns nothing. The game files never use it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; presumably the new on/off value.

label: Toggle grid
summary: Shows or hides the entity editor's grid.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Toggle Grid" button. It returns nothing.

label: Toggle needle follows keyframe
summary: Switches on or off whether the needle (the current time marker) moves along when a keyframe is dragged.
details: Vanilla runs it from the toggle button next to the timeline. It returns nothing.

label: Toggle world mute
summary: Mutes all sound except the entity editor's own, or turns it back on.
details: Vanilla runs it from the mute button. It returns nothing.

label: Audio handler itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the editor's audio event handler itself.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Add sound parameter
summary: Adds a sound parameter to the sound event of the given keyframe.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Add Sound Parameter" button of the event editor. The misspelling "Paramter" is the game's own and must be written that way. It returns nothing.

fields.name: keyframe
fields.text: The keyframe whose sound event gets the parameter.

label: Remove last sound parameter
summary: Removes the sound parameter added last from the sound event of the given keyframe.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Remove Last" button of the event editor. It returns nothing.

fields.name: keyframe
fields.text: The keyframe whose sound event loses the parameter.

label: Audio handler itself
summary: Going by its name, the audio event handler itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Event layer itself
summary: The entity editor's event layer (a timeline lane) itself, to hand it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the entity editor's OnLayerRightClick and SetClickedLane on a right-click. The game lists no return type.

label: Add start event
summary: Adds a new start event (a keyframe listed under "Start Events") to the layer.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Add New Start Event" button of the entity editor's properties tab, passing the editor. It returns nothing.

label: Has keyframes
summary: Whether the layer has any keyframes.
details: Vanilla shows the layer's list of keyframes in the properties tab only while the layer is opened and this is true.

label: Is expanded
summary: Whether the layer is opened up in the entity editor's properties tab.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of the layer's open button and shows the layer's contents only while it is true.

label: Is hovered
summary: Whether the mouse is over the layer's lane in the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla draws the layer fully opaque while it is true and faded (40%) otherwise, and uses it as a button's checked state.

label: Layer keyframe
summary: The keyframes of the layer, as a list.
details: Vanilla builds one keyframe button per entry in the layer's timeline lane and one row per entry in the properties tab. The game lists no return type.

label: Event layer itself
summary: Going by its name, the event layer itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Set hovered
summary: Sets whether the layer counts as hovered by the mouse.
details: Vanilla runs it with `yes` when the mouse enters the layer's lane and with `no` when it leaves. It returns nothing.

fields.name: hovered
fields.text: Whether the mouse is over the lane.

label: Layer title
summary: The title of the layer, shown as its name in the entity editor.
details: Vanilla shows it as the layer's label in the timeline and the properties tab, and also uses it to name the layer's widget ("layer_..."). The game lists no return type.

label: Toggle expanded
summary: Opens or closes the layer in the entity editor's properties tab.
details: Vanilla runs it from the layer's open button. It returns nothing.

label: Keyframe itself
summary: The keyframe itself, to hand it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the entity editor's keyframe functions: click, press, release, right-click, delete, opening the event editor and the sound parameter buttons. The game lists no return type.

label: Has event
summary: Going by its name, whether the keyframe has an event attached.
details: It returns yes or no. The game files never use it.

label: Is hovered
summary: Going by its name, whether the mouse is over the keyframe.
details: It returns yes or no. The name "IsHovered" appears 50 times in the game's files, but the input shows no line for this type.

label: Is selected
summary: Whether the keyframe is selected in the entity editor's timeline.
details: Vanilla picks a different frame of the keyframe button's picture while it is true, so a selected keyframe looks different.

label: Is start event
summary: Whether the keyframe is a start event.
details: Vanilla leaves start events out of the timeline lane and lists them in the properties tab's "Start Events" section instead.

label: Keyframe color
summary: The color the keyframe's button is drawn in.
details: It returns four decimal numbers (a CVector4f), the form the game uses for colors. Vanilla sets it as the color of each keyframe button in the timeline.

label: Keyframe label
summary: The keyframe's label text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the keyframe button's tooltip together with its time, and on the "Edit ..." button of a start event.

label: Keyframe itself
summary: The keyframe itself, to hand it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the entity editor's OnKeyframeMove while a keyframe is dragged; the other keyframe functions get AccessSelf instead. The game lists no return type.

label: Set hovered
summary: Going by its name, sets whether the keyframe counts as hovered by the mouse.
details: It takes one argument, presumably yes or no, and returns nothing. The game files never use it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; presumably the new hovered value.

label: Set selected
summary: Going by its name, selects or deselects the keyframe.
details: It takes one argument, presumably yes or no, and returns nothing. The input shows no line using it for this type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; presumably the new selected value.

label: Keyframe time
summary: The point in the animation where the keyframe sits, in seconds, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the keyframe button's position on the timeline and shows it with two decimals and "s" in the tooltip.

label: Timeline state itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the editor's timeline state itself.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Animation length
summary: Going by its name, the length of the animation shown in the timeline, as a decimal number.
details: The unit is not documented. The game files never use it.

label: Keyframe layers
summary: Going by its name, the layers of keyframes shown in the timeline.
details: The game gives no return type. The game files never use it.

label: Timeline name
summary: Going by its name, the name of the timeline.
details: The game gives no return type. The name "Name" appears 13 times in the game's files, but the input shows no line for this type.

label: Timeline state itself
summary: Going by its name, the timeline state itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Viewer properties itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the entity viewer's properties object itself.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Clear selection
summary: Going by its name, clears what is selected in the entity viewer.
details: It returns nothing. The input shows no line using it for this type; other types have a function of the same name (for example in the multiplayer lobby and the geographical regions window), which is only a hint.

label: Environment tab open
summary: Whether the environment settings are the open part of the entity editor's properties tab.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of the "Open Environment Settings" button and shows the Environment section only while it is true.

label: Mesh tab open
summary: Whether the mesh settings (the 3D model's details) are the open part of the entity editor's properties tab.
details: Vanilla uses it as the checked state of the "Open Mesh Settings" button and shows the Mesh section (scale, joints, vertices and triangles per level of detail) only while it is true.

label: Open environment settings
summary: Switches the entity editor's properties tab to the environment settings.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Open Environment Settings" button. It returns nothing.

label: Open mesh settings
summary: Switches the entity editor's properties tab to the mesh settings.
details: Vanilla runs it from the "Open Mesh Settings" button. It returns nothing.

label: Viewer properties itself
summary: Going by its name, the entity viewer's properties object itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Entry itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the list entry itself, so it can be passed to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Entry description
summary: Going by its name, the description text of a list entry.
details: It returns a string. The input shows no line using it for this type; similar functions on other types (building, government type) produce description text.

label: Entry icon
summary: The icon of one choice in an option list.
details: Vanilla sets a widget's `texture` to it inside decision view widgets (option lists such as the commission-artifact and convert-to-mandala widgets). The game gives no return type.

label: Entry blocker text
summary: Going by its name, the text that says why an entry cannot be chosen.
details: It returns a string. The game files never use it.

label: Entry name
summary: The name of one choice in an option list.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text of a choice in decision view widgets. It returns a string.

label: Entry tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of one choice in an option list.
details: Vanilla sets a widget's `tooltip` to it in decision view widgets. It returns a string.

label: Entry is enabled
summary: Whether a choice in an option list can currently be chosen.
details: Vanilla sets a widget's `enabled` to it in decision view widgets, so a disabled choice cannot be clicked.

label: Entry has flat icon
summary: Whether the choice's icon is a flat icon (judged from how it is used).
details: Vanilla uses it, and its negation, to show or hide widgets in the generic option-list decision widgets, so the icon is drawn one way or the other. That it means a flat icon is judged from the name.

label: Entry is selected
summary: Whether this choice is the one currently selected in the option list.
details: Vanilla sets a button's `down` (pressed look) to it in decision view widgets.

label: Entry itself
summary: The list entry itself, passed to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it on a click: `DecisionViewWidgetOptionList.OnSelect(Entry.Self)`, which selects that entry. The game gives no return type.

label: Setting choice itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the settings choice itself.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Setting of this choice
summary: The setting this choice belongs to.
details: Vanilla passes it with the choice's value string to `SelectEnumWithString` when a choice is clicked in the settings. The game gives no return type.

label: Choice value string
summary: The value of this choice as a string.
details: Vanilla passes it, with the setting itself, to `SelectEnumWithString` on a click in the settings, presumably to select this choice (judged from that function's name).

label: Choice display name
summary: The name of this choice as shown in the settings.
details: Vanilla shows it as widget text in the settings interface. It returns a UTF-8 string.

label: Recommended note
summary: The note that marks a choice of a game setting as the recommended one, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it right after the choice's name in the entries of a settings list.

label: Choice tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of this choice in the settings.
details: Vanilla sets a widget's `tooltip` to it in the settings interface. It returns a UTF-8 string.

label: Choice is selected
summary: Whether this choice is the one currently set.
details: Vanilla uses it, and its negation, to decide which widget is visible in the settings, so the selected choice looks different.

label: Setting choice itself
summary: Going by its name, the settings choice itself, handed on to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type. The lines the input shows for the name "Self" belong to other types, so this rests on the name only.

label: Epidemic itself
summary: Going by its name, gives access to the epidemic itself, so it can be passed to other functions.
details: The game gives no return type and the input shows no use of it for this type.

label: Infected in domain
summary: How many holdings (or counties) of a character's domain the epidemic has infected.
details: Vanilla shows it as "domain infections: X/Y" with the character's domain size as the second number. What exactly is counted is judged from that use. It returns a whole number.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character whose domain is counted.

label: Infection chance
summary: The chance that a character catches this epidemic's disease in a given place.
details: Vanilla shows it in tooltips "Chance of contracting [disease] in ...", once for the character's current location and once for a specific province, formatted as a percentage. It returns a fixed-point number. What the two arguments are is judged from those uses.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character who might catch the disease.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The place the chance is for.

label: Custom text
summary: Going by its name, runs a named custom localization text on the epidemic.
details: It takes the name of a custom text (a string) and returns the text. The name `Custom` appears 11101 times in the game's files, but the lines the input shows are for other types (a character), so this rests on the name and those hints.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The key of the custom localization.

label: Infection data in province
summary: Information about the epidemic's infection in a province.
details: Vanilla reads two things from the result in the tooltip of an infected province: `.GetInfectionRate` (shown as "Infection Rate", as a percentage) and `.GetStartDate` (shown as "Outbreak Start"). The game gives no return type.

label: Infection level in province
summary: Going by its name, how far the epidemic has spread in a province.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source (`datacontext`) of a widget in the county view, with the holding's province as the argument. What it returns is judged from the name. The game gives no return type.

label: Intensity name
summary: The name of the epidemic's outbreak intensity.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in epidemic tooltips and the epidemic window. Other lines test for the intensities `minor`, `major` and `apocalyptic`. It returns a string.

label: Epidemic name
summary: The name of the epidemic.
details: Vanilla shows it as text on the HUD. Going by the names, it comes with a tooltip and `GetNameNoTooltip` is the plain version. It returns a string.

label: Epidemic name, plain
summary: The name of the epidemic as plain text, without a tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it inside other texts, such as the global notification and the province tooltips of infected or safe provinces. It returns a string.

label: Outbreak start date
summary: The date the epidemic's outbreak began.
details: Vanilla shows it with `.GetString` in "Outbreak began in [province] on [date]". The game gives no return type.

label: Outbreak start province
summary: The province where the epidemic's outbreak began.
details: Vanilla shows its name in "Outbreak began in [province]". The game gives no return type.

label: Total deaths
summary: How many characters the epidemic has killed so far.
details: Vanilla shows it as the epidemic's death toll ("fatalities") in the epidemic window. It returns a whole number.

label: Total infected characters
summary: Going by its name, how many characters are infected by the epidemic.
details: It returns a whole number. The game files never use it.

label: Total infected provinces
summary: Going by its name, how many provinces are infected by the epidemic.
details: It returns a whole number. The game files never use it.

label: Epidemic type
summary: The type of the epidemic (the kind of disease it is).
details: Vanilla gets its name with `.GetName`, a localized text with `.Localize( 'global_notification' )`, and uses it as a widget's data source in the epidemic window. The game gives no return type.

label: Has infection in
summary: Going by its name, whether the epidemic has infected the given province.
details: It takes one argument, presumably a province, and returns yes or no. The game files never use it.

label: Has outbreak intensity
summary: Whether the epidemic's outbreak has the given intensity.
details: Vanilla tests it with `'minor'`, `'major'` and `'apocalyptic'` to show a widget for each level.

label: Is hovered
summary: Going by its name, whether the mouse is over the epidemic.
details: It returns yes or no. The name appears 50 times in the game's files, but the lines the input shows are for other types.

label: Is in realm
summary: Going by its name, whether the epidemic is in the given character's realm.
details: Vanilla passes the player and uses it to show a part of the epidemic tooltip. The meaning of "in realm" is judged from the name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The ruler whose realm is checked.

label: Is irrelevant for
summary: Going by its name, whether the epidemic does not matter for the given character.
details: It takes one argument, presumably a character, and returns yes or no. The game files never use it.

label: Is near realm
summary: Going by its name, whether the epidemic is near the given character's realm.
details: Vanilla passes the player and uses it to show a part of the epidemic tooltip. How near counts is not documented.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The ruler whose realm is checked.

label: Is selected
summary: Going by its name, whether the epidemic is selected.
details: It returns yes or no. The name appears 105 times in the game's files, but the lines the input shows are for other types.

label: Is valid
summary: Going by its name, whether the epidemic object is valid.
details: It returns yes or no. The name appears 1031 times in the game's files, but the lines the input shows are for other types. See `IsValidCheck` for the one vanilla uses on epidemics.

label: Is valid check
summary: Going by its name, whether the epidemic is valid.
details: Vanilla uses it to decide whether a widget is visible, on the HUD and in the epidemic window. The exact check is not documented.

label: Make scope
summary: Going by its name, turns the epidemic into a script scope, so script values and similar can be read from it.
details: It returns a scope. The name appears 1043 times in the game's files, but the lines the input shows are for a character (`GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue(...)`), so this rests on the name and that hint.

label: On mouse enter
summary: Tells the game the mouse has moved onto the epidemic's map icon.
details: Vanilla calls it in `on_start` of a map icon (map_icon_layer_templates.gui). It returns nothing. What the game then does (for example highlighting) is judged from the name.

label: On mouse leave
summary: Tells the game the mouse has left the epidemic's map icon.
details: Vanilla calls it in `on_start` of a map icon (map_icon_layer_templates.gui). It returns nothing. What the game then does is judged from the name.

label: Pan camera to
summary: Going by its name, moves the map camera to the epidemic.
details: It returns nothing. The input shows no line using it for this type; the same name on a character and an activity location moves the camera there on a click.

label: Epidemic itself
summary: The epidemic itself, passed to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to `ToggleGameViewData( 'epidemics', Epidemic.Self )` (going by the function's name, opens the epidemic view for it) and to `GetPlayer.HasInfection( Epidemic.Self )`. The game gives no return type.

label: Zoom camera to
summary: Going by its name, zooms the map camera to the epidemic.
details: Vanilla calls it on a click in the epidemic window. What the camera does is judged from the name. It returns nothing.
